definitions.explanation: The first half of a time period, event, game, or other divisible whole. Commonly used for halves of sports matches, decades, books, and similar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前半|ぜんはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The first half of the game ended.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前半|ぜんはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テンポ→テンポ：04749_tenpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}かった→遅い：00533_osoi⟧。
examples.english: The first half of the movie had a slow pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前半|ぜんはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: The first half of this year was busy, but things calmed down a bit in the second half.

notes:
{前半|ぜんはん} refers to the first half of any divisible period, event, or work — sports matches, years, books, movies, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前半|ぜんはん}⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧: first half of a match
- ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前半|ぜんはん}: first half of the year
- {前半|ぜんはん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧: first half and second half
- ～⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧{前半|ぜんはん}: early part of a decade (e.g., 2020⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧{前半|ぜんはん} = early 2020s)

USAGE:
Always paired conceptually with ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧ (second half). In sports, the halftime break separates {前半|ぜんはん} and ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧. For books or movies, it refers roughly to the first half of the content.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前半|ぜんはん}: first half (of a defined whole)
- ⟦{前期|ぜんき}→前期：20651_zenki⟧: first term/period (academic or fiscal)
- ⟦{序盤|じょばん}→序盤：12450_joban⟧: opening phase (more flexible, not exactly half)
